metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. FUJIFILM motion picture film data sheet KB-0701E (2007-03 (print code SK-07.03)), eterna_vivid160.pdf, PDF page(s) 1, FUJICOLOR ETERNA Vivid 160 8543 / 8643: https://modusdever.com/assets/Manuais/fuji/eterna_vivid160.pdf Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): the characteristic curves are printed against camera stops: converted to relative log H (1 stop = 0.30103), the absolute exposure scale comes from the builder's speed-point anchoring; spectral sensitivity on a relative log scale (one log unit = the interval marked '1.0'), absolute level from the builder's mid-grey anchoring; sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; base+fog and mid-scale dye densities read from the sheet, individual CMY dyes reconstructed by the builder (not printed); dye densities outside the printed 400-700 nm; print stock: KODAK VISION 2383 (the shipped cine print profile; FUJIFILM ETERNA-CP 3513/3514 is not in the repository); interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet; runtime default for negatives). Original data are property of the respective holders.
